message.content:
To retrieve just the IDs of the CNAME records for **sample.com** via VirusTotal’s v3 API, you can query the *records* endpoint with a filter for `CNAME` record types and then pull out the `id` field from each returned object.

```bash
# Example using curl (replace <YOUR_API_KEY> with your actual key)
curl -s \
     -H "x-apikey: <YOUR_API_KEY>" \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/records?record_type=CNAME" |
jq '.data[].id'
```

If you prefer Python:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "<YOUR_API_KEY>"
url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com/records"
params = {"record_type": "CNAME"}

headers = {"x-apikey": API_KEY}
resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)

# Extract the list of IDs
ids = [item["id"] for item in resp.json().get("data", [])]
print(ids)
```

Both snippets will output a list of the unique identifiers for each CNAME record associated with `sample.com`.
